items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: Bernice is a friend of mine who is a very good pianist.

ctx.x: Her name was Tilden. Her father was Dr. Tilden at that time in Chicago. Anyhow, I lost contact with them. So, a few months later, I happened to put the radio on in my house and I heard this piece called 'Prelude to a Kiss.' The minute I heard it, I said, 'Oooooh! That's mine.' And right away (inaudible), I said, 'That's my piece.' I didn't know that my middle was in there. I was surprised too. So then I heard, 'da, la, la, la. Then I heard -- 'Oh, that's mine!' to myself. And that was that. And that's that.

It just goes to show you some of these sections of tunes can show up in some of the most unusual places. Bernice is a friend of mine who is a very good pianist. And right now, we ran into each other at Davidson Senior Center. Bernice is the house pianist for the senior center.
That's why I come over here today. See what happens?
